北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感舒适，记得及时补充水分哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy, feels pleasant. Remember to stay hydrated!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波小雨，湿度大，出行记得带伞，注意路面湿滑。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has light rain, high humidity. Bring an umbrella and watch out for slippery roads.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感略闷热，请注意清淡饮食，多喝水。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and feels a bit stuffy. Eat light and drink more water.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感热，记得防晒，补充水分哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and hot. Remember sun protection and hydration!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感闷热，多补充水分，注意休息。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast and muggy. Drink plenty of water and rest well.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，能见度低，驾车出行请减速慢行，注意安全。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has fog, visibility is low. Drive slowly and carefully.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，湿度高，午后有点晒，记得防晒补水哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny with high humidity. It's a bit sunny in the afternoon, remember sun protection and hydration.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感炎热，注意防暑，多喝水。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels very hot. Protect yourself from heatstroke, drink more water.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，湿度大，体感闷热，注意防暑降温哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy with high humidity, feels muggy. Stay cool and prevent heatstroke.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感有点热，请注意补水，保持好心情。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels a bit hot. Remember to hydrate and stay cheerful.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗炎热，紫外线强，外出务必做好防晒，多饮水。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and hot with strong UV. Be sure to protect yourself from sun, drink plenty of water.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，风力较大，出门注意防风，多加件衣服哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy with strong winds. Mind the wind and wear an extra layer.
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，湿度较大，体感略凉，注意适量添衣。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy with high humidity, feels a bit cool. Add appropriate layers.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气候宜人，早晚温差大，记得备件外套哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy with pleasant weather. Mind the temperature difference, bring a jacket.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，湿度高，体感略闷，注意清淡饮食，多休息。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with high humidity, feels a bit stuffy. Eat light and get more rest.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，风力适中，体感舒适，户外活动很棒哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny with moderate wind, feels pleasant. Great for outdoor activities!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连小雨，湿度较大，记得带伞，注意保暖防着凉。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has light rain, high humidity. Bring an umbrella, stay warm to avoid colds.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，体感闷热，多喝水，注意防暑降温。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is cloudy and muggy. Drink plenty of water, stay cool.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，湿度大，出行记得带伞，注意防潮！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain, high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella, mind the damp!
